reason: It's right where I work, it has free Wi-Fi and 70 seats, and it's open until midnight, so I can sit and study after work. I'd walk in, not order delivery, and make one Americano or Turkish coffee last a few hours.
objection: On my salary 3 dinars a drink adds up fast, so I can only treat myself about once a week. I'm also not sure they're fine with someone sitting for hours on one cheap drink, or that there are enough plugs.
would_change_my_mind: A student or study deal, like a cheaper Americano with a refill or a stamp card, would get me in two or three times a week instead of once.
